newsitem.title: UK: UK approves vitamin B-2 from engineered bacteria.
newsitem.headline: UK approves vitamin B-2 from engineered bacteria.

text.p: The government on Tuesday gave the the safety clearance to riboflavin, better known as vitamin B-2, derived from genetically modified bacteria through fermentation technology.

The riboflavin produced by engineered bacteria, which normally produces only small amounts of the vitamin, is identical to that produced by traditional chemical means, the ministry of agriculture, fisheries and food said.
The "new" riboflavin will be used to fortify processed foods such as breakfast cereals and soft drinks.
In deciding to give the safety clearance, the government followed and earlier advice from an independent committee on novel foods and processes.
